name: ljit-mcp-sfmc
description: 44 ferramentas para o Salesforce Marketing Cloud: Data Extensions, Content Builder, Journey Builder, Transactional Messaging e Marketing Cloud Personalization (leitura).
long_description: MCP server para o Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC). Permite que o Claude gerencie Data Extensions, assets do Content Builder, jornadas do Journey Builder, envie mensagens transacionais e leia dados do Marketing Cloud Personalization — tudo via linguagem natural. As variáveis de Personalization (MCP_PERS_*) são opcionais: preencha apenas se for usar as ferramentas pers_*.

sfmc_client_id.title: SFMC Client ID
sfmc_client_id.description: Client ID da installed package (API Integration) no SFMC

sfmc_client_secret.title: SFMC Client Secret
sfmc_client_secret.description: Client Secret da installed package no SFMC

sfmc_subdomain.title: SFMC Subdomain
sfmc_subdomain.description: Prefixo da URL de auth: https://<subdomain>.auth.marketingcloudapis.com (apenas o <subdomain>)

sfmc_account_id.title: SFMC Account ID (MID) — opcional
sfmc_account_id.description: MID de uma child Business Unit. Deixe em branco para a BU padrão.

mcp_pers_account.title: Personalization — Account (opcional)
mcp_pers_account.description: Parte da URL: https://<account>.<instance>.evergage.com. Só para ferramentas pers_*.

mcp_pers_instance.title: Personalization — Instance (opcional)
mcp_pers_instance.description: Pod/região na URL (ex: us-5). Só para ferramentas pers_*.

mcp_pers_dataset.title: Personalization — Dataset (opcional)
mcp_pers_dataset.description: Dataset alvo das operações. Só para ferramentas pers_*.

mcp_pers_api_key_id.title: Personalization — API Key ID (opcional)
mcp_pers_api_key_id.description: API Token (Security > API Tokens) no Personalization. Só para ferramentas pers_*.

mcp_pers_api_secret.title: Personalization — API Secret (opcional)
mcp_pers_api_secret.description: Secret do API Token no Personalization. Só para ferramentas pers_*.
